Build a complete, production-ready landing page on the first attempt. - **Theme:** Daguerreotype — 1839–1860s early photographic aesthetic (silvery monochrome, warm sepia-silver undertone, soft vignette falloff, oval/gilt-edge framing, quiet formal stillness) - **Output Category:** Cultural & Heritage - **Sections:** Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links - **All user-facing copy must be written in English.** No lorem-ipsum-only submissions; write real, period-appropriate English copy per the direction in Section 6. --- ## 1. Zero exceptions. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must live in `style.css`, targeted via class or ID selectors. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain semantic and styling-agnostic. Changing the site's look must require editing only `style.css`, never the markup. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Store every visual token in `:root` using the mandatory canonical names below, mapped onto the Daguerreotype palette. Keep the theme-specific supplementary tokens (vignette, gilt-edge, sepia, silver, plate shadows) alongside them. Documented exceptions allowed: form input groups (`align-items: stretch`), footer link columns (`flex-start`). - **Mobile-First:** Build all layouts as mobile-first flex columns, promoting to rows at breakpoints (e.g., `min-width: 768px` / `1024px`). Horizontal scrolling is forbidden at any viewport width. - **Containers:** Max content width ~1100px, centered; section padding via `--space-*` tokens. ### 1.5 Styling Approach & Naming Convention - **Clean Custom CSS:** The reference specification is hand-authored CSS — extend it; do not replace it. The provided base classes (`.nav`, `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.card`, `.input`, `.badge`) are the mandatory foundation. If you choose Tailwind instead, every utility must map back to these CSS variables and generic reusable class names. - **BEM Only:** One consistent convention — BEM (`block__element--modifier`) — across the entire deliverable. Never mix conventions. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - **Text Fonts:** Load via Google Fonts `` with `preconnect`: **Cormorant** (body, weights 400/600/700 + italic), **Playfair Display** (display, 400/700/900 + italic), **EB Garamond** (fallback). Bind to `--font-base` / `--font-display`. - **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the official stylesheet. Usage: `icon_name`. - **Forbidden:** Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji-as-icons, icon fonts other than Material Symbols. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--ghost`) - **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` — minimum touch target 44×44px; `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)`. - **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-1px)` + `box-shadow: var(--shadow-plate)`; `cursor: pointer`. - **Focus:** `.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }` — never remove focus rings. - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. - **Loading (`.btn--loading`):** `pointer-events: none` to prevent double-clicks; render a CSS-only spinner (border-based, using `currentColor`) without changing button dimensions. - **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(0.6); cursor: not-allowed;` — no shadow, no transform. - **Success/Error (`.btn--success`, `.btn--error`):** Temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` and matching border tokens; never color-only — pair with an icon or text change. ### 2.2 Card (`.card` and variants) - **Default:** Flexbox layout, `background: var(--bg-secondary)`, `box-shadow: var(--gilt-edge), var(--shadow-plate)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, and the signature `::after` vignette overlay (`--vignette-gradient`, `pointer-events: none`). - **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + shadow shift to `--shadow-md`. - **Focus-within:** Card border/edge highlights when a child link or button receives focus. - **Skeleton (`.card--skeleton`):** Shimmer animation (gradient sweep) defined in CSS to prevent layout jumps; respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. - **Empty (`.card--empty`):** Centered fallback layout — one Material Symbol icon + short guidance text. ### 2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`, `.input`) - **Structure:** Flex container wrapping `
